title: Chart Of Accounts — operating knowledge
content: Finance must understand chart of accounts as an operational capability, not as a generic definition. The knowledge must identify the business purpose, owners, inputs, outputs, evidence, decision thresholds, failure conditions and downstream effects. It must preserve the department charter — Keep financial records complete, cash visible, budgets controlled, tax obligations tracked and management reporting decision-useful. — and contribute to the north-star outcome: Accurate books, controlled cash burn, timely collections and no unmanaged tax or payment exposure. Knowledge records should distinguish stable policy from live operational facts and should point to live tables rather than copying values that change.

structured_data.north_star: Accurate books, controlled cash burn, timely collections and no unmanaged tax or payment exposure.

structured_data.north_star: Accurate books, controlled cash burn, timely collections and no unmanaged tax or payment exposure.
